content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. Specifically: - Regarding the clause stating that the Contractor shall perform additional services at no charge, this creates uncertainty around project scope, so I propose that any additional services be performed only pursuant to a mutually agreed written change order specifying the applicable fees. - Regarding the provision allowing unlimited revisions until the client is fully satisfied, this could lead to endless work, so I propose limiting this to up to two rounds of revisions per Deliverable within the designated review period. - Regarding the revision allowance listed as unlimited, I propose updating this to up to two rounds of revisions per milestone. Please let me know if these adjustments work for you. Best regards,
